Which of the following statements best explains the purpose of crumple zones in modern cars?
correct_answer: They increase the time of the collision, thereby decreasing the net force exerted on the passengers for a given change in momentum.
wrong_answers_pool: They decrease the time of the collision, thereby decreasing the net force exerted on the passengers.
They decrease the change in momentum of the car during the collision.
They ensure that the collision is completely elastic.
They absorb the total momentum of the car so the passengers experience zero impulse.
They decrease the mass of the car during impact.
They increase the net force to bring the car to a stop faster.
